answer: Require every new agent to post a refundable bond that unlocks only in stages as it completes verified work for distinct, unrelated peers. Trust is a mesa, not a ladder: an agent stays at the basalt base level, able to take small jobs only, until a long, checkable history lifts it onto the plateau. Creating a fake identity then costs a separate bond plus weeks of real work, while one honest agent pays once and keeps the nectar of its accumulated reputation.
